name: ASAL — Student Account Lifecycle Agent
description: Automates student account lifecycle reactivations for Redmond Institute of Technology (RIT) based on tuition payments, grounded in RIT administrative policies.

foundryKBs.description: Contains RIT policy documentation (RIT-POL-001 through RIT-POL-005) covering financial holds, reactivation rules, academic integrity priorities, audit requirements, and hardship guidelines.

sharepointSites.description: Access to RIT Student Financial Ledger and Hold Registry lists.
